findings.title: Repeated resume events abort a newly opened SSE stream while catalog verification is pending
findings.trigger: After 31 seconds, focus opens a replacement stream and starts a slow snapshot. Online/visibility/focus notifications arrive before the snapshot completes.
findings.impact: Each resume closes the replacement and opens another handshake, causing avoidable requests and delaying event recovery.
findings.fix: Track stream opening time and replace only a stream older than the 30-second freshness interval (or after a backwards clock change).
findings.green: 2 tests pass; adjacent controller/session suites also pass

findings.title: Clamping a long device wait ends it before its advertised deadline
findings.trigger: A valid server-provided device interval or Retry-After exceeds 2147483647 milliseconds while the device code remains valid.
findings.impact: The client polls before the advertised due time; a subsequent cancel can arrive after an unexpectedly early exchange.
findings.fix: Rearm bounded timer chunks until the original deadline; retain immediate wake and abort cleanup.
findings.applicability: Boundary case supported by the parser; the delivered API currently documents a 600-second device lifetime and 5-second initial interval.
findings.red: 3 failed tests (early interval, early Retry-After, cancellation after the first chunk)
findings.green: 3 regressions and all adjacent client/session tests pass

findings.title: Debug report copy violates its caller's Promise contract and swallows fallback failure
findings.repro: DebugPanel.copy calls copyToClipboard(debugReport()).then(...). Both successful native copying and browser fallback returned undefined, causing a TypeError; a rejected browser clipboard write was additionally swallowed.
findings.fix: Return an async result, await native/browser completion and propagate fallback failure to the existing shared caller. No shared UI edit.
findings.regression: tests/q18BetterdiscordShims.test.ts: three clipboard cases for native success, deferred browser success and browser rejection.
findings.red: All three failed before the production change: undefined.then / .rejects received undefined. All pass after the fix.

findings.title: Flux hook retains listeners after partial registration or transient removal errors
findings.repro: ChannelStore.addChangeListener installs the hook callback then throws; the callback was never recorded in attached and survives unmount. Alternatively removeChangeListener throws once before removal and cleanup abandons it. Reopening TicketSettings accumulates dormant callbacks.
findings.fix: Record cleanup ownership before calling host registration and retry one failed removal while preserving the existing retired-callback guard.
findings.regression: tests/q18BetterdiscordShims.test.ts: two Flux ownership cases, including remount and stale-callback checks.
findings.red: Both failed with one listener remaining after unmount; both pass with zero listeners after the fix.

findings.title: A late host download response outlives the cancelled updater request
findings.repro: Stop/timeout aborts the shared receiver while BdApi.Net.fetch has not returned. If the bridge returns a body later, hostTransport handed that body to an abandoned promise without cancelling it. An already-aborted request could also initiate network work.
findings.fix: Reject before issuing an already-aborted request; after the host returns, cancel a response whose owning signal has been aborted before exposing its reader.
findings.regression: tests/q18BetterdiscordUpdater.test.ts: late-body cancellation and pre-aborted request cases.
findings.red: Both previously resolved instead of rejecting; the new checks reject ABORTED, cancel the late body once and avoid the pre-aborted fetch.

findings.title: Corrupt pending metadata permanently disables native update repair at startup
findings.repro: Write malformed pending.json in a temporary native staging directory, then call prepareUpdates. applyPending threw, prepareUpdates stopped the updater, and the entry fell back to bundled UI without an engine to run the existing quarantine/repair check. The same receipt breaks every later startup.
findings.fix: Report the startup-apply error but retain checks and independently verify/load any existing runtime. The existing shared engine quarantines the damaged pending record during its next check.
findings.regression: tests/q18BetterdiscordUpdater.test.ts: real temporary staging metadata, mocked HTTPS returning an empty release list, verify quarantine and a usable updater.
findings.red: Startup rejected with JSON SyntaxError before the production change. The initial post-fix test exposed a VM-harness exception-brand mismatch; injecting host SyntaxError alongside the harness's host JSON corrected the fixture. The final scenario passes without live network.

findings.title: An incompatible verified runtime disables future native update checks
findings.repro: Create a correctly hashed temporary runtime with a valid receipt but an exported class missing the loader contract. prepareUpdates threw Incompatible cached runtime, stopped updates and left the bundled runtime unable to obtain a repairing release.
findings.fix: Stop the unusable engine and return a fresh engine at the bundled version with Plugin:null. This preserves repair and avoids advertising the rejected cache version as the running version.
findings.regression: tests/q18BetterdiscordUpdater.test.ts: incompatible real cached module and subsequent offline mocked check reporting the bundled version.
findings.red: The added regression initially failed with Incompatible cached runtime and passes after the fix.

findings.title: Delegated settings render duplicate version and update-status headers
findings.repro: The bootstrap settings panel renders its header, then delegate.getBundledSettings returned another complete settings panel including a second header and an unrelated default update-status line.
findings.fix: The delegated body suppresses its header; the owning bootstrap keeps the actual update status and selected runtime version. A directly running bundled plugin retains its header.
findings.regression: tests/q18BetterdiscordEntry.test.ts: render actual entry JSX through a local component model, verify a single header/service/settings control and the selected version, plus the direct-runtime control case.
findings.red: The delegated case initially rendered two headers instead of one; the direct-runtime control already passed. Both now pass.

findings.title: Automatic repaired-save write can overwrite later accepted settings

findings.reachability: Damaged preferences repaired on startup/retry plus slow async storage; subsequent settings edits use a different write tail from the original repair.
findings.fix: Enqueue repaired saves through changed(), so they participate in lastSave/flush and serialize with personal and preference writes.
findings.regression: tests/q18CoreState.test.ts: serializes automatic repair with later writes and includes repair in flush
